newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Caltex Singapore tenders to sell 60,000/T fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Caltex Singapore tenders to sell 60,000/T fuel oil.

text.p: Caltex Singapore has issued two tenders to sell a total of 50,000 tonnes of 380-centistoke fuel oil and 10,000 tonnes of 180-centistoke for April lifting, industry sources said on Tuesday.
In the first tender, Caltex offers 20,000 tonnes of 380-cst fuel oil for April 26-28 lifting free-on-board Singapore basis, the sources said.
The second tender offers 30,000 tonnes of 380-cst and 10,000 tonnes of 180-cst fuel oil for in-tank-transfer (ITT) on April 15.
Both tenders close on April 9 and are valid until April 10.
